title: commercial-bounds/v0
description: A private document holding the user's commercial bounds: today the lowest total they will take (min_total_minor, a seller's floor). It is never sealed in a record and never shared: records carry only bounds_commitment, SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of {"nonce", "text"} where text is this document's own JCS bytes and nonce a fresh 256-bit value (commit_alg sha256-jcs-nonce256). The user's own copy carries the opening, so the floor can be checked against the commitment on the user's own device.
